csv_project_name: A/E Services for Berkeley County Bond Projects 2026-2027
csv_scope_of_work: The Berkeley County Board of Education is inviting qualified firms to submit a Statement of Qualifications (SOQ) for providing Architectural/Engineering (A/E) design & construction administration services for the New 2026-2027 Bond Projects in Berkeley County, West Virginia. The Board reserves the right to select one firm, multiple firms, or firms assigned to specific projects or groups of projects, based on qualifications, project needs, capacity, and the best interests of Berkeley County Schools. Traditional Design and Construction Administration Services will be required per the requirements of the SBA Policy & Procedures Handbook. All services will be performed by qualified professionals in collaboration with the county administrative staff and the SBA. The creation of an Educational Specification and a Program of Spaces shall be administered by the County and may include support and input from the SBA staff; however, the A/E shall provide support during the Planning Phase as required.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management
